csv_scope_of_work: The City of Nashua s Division of Public Works (DPW) wishes to select two or more professional engineering firm(s) to provide engineering services in Street, Bridge, Traffic, Bicycle &, Pedestrian, Survey, and Construction Engineering disciplines on an as-needed, project-specific basis. The DPW requires engineering services in the above disciplines to support and maintain its infrastructure and facilities, and to complete federally funded local public agency (LPA) projects in partnership with the NH Department of Transportation (NHDOT).

title: Nashua City Engineering Services
short_description: As-needed multidisciplinary engineering services for streets, bridges, traffic, bicycle, pedestrian, survey, and construction projects.
project_scope: Selection of two or more professional engineering firms to provide as-needed, project-specific engineering services for the City of Nashua Division of Public Works. Scope covers support for municipal infrastructure and facilities and federally funded Local Public Agency projects with NHDOT. Disciplines include street, bridge, traffic, bicycle and pedestrian, survey, and construction engineering, as well as civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, planning/master planning, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. No specific structure, span, floor area, or individual project quantities are defined.
services: On-call professional engineering services on a project-specific basis, including civil, structural, geotechnical, traffic, bridge, bicycle and pedestrian, survey/GIS/mapping, planning/master planning, and construction engineering services.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call engineering services for multiple future assignments rather than a defined single project.
- Includes bridge, structural, bicycle, and pedestrian disciplines, which are generally relevant to sbp.
- However, no specific bridge or special structure is identified, so structural complexity and innovation cannot be assessed.
- Broad municipal DPW scope includes many disciplines outside sbp's core focus.
- The brief indicates multiple contracts may be awarded, reducing strategic specificity.
- Framework agreements for multiple bridges are explicitly lower priority in the guidance.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. This is an as-needed engineering services procurement for multiple future projects, so no realistic single construction cost estimate can be derived from the notice.
fee_explanation: No fee, contract value, or estimated engineering budget is stated. The notice only indicates an on-call arrangement with a 36-month base period and 24-month renewal option.
references_qualifications: Professional engineering firms are sought for as-needed municipal infrastructure services. Requested qualifications/disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, planning/master planning, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. The excerpt does not specify minimum numbers of reference projects or detailed qualification thresholds.
contracting_authority: City of Nashua Purchasing, City of Nashua, Nashua, New Hampshire, USA. Contact: Amy Girard. Phone: 603-589-3332. Fax: 603-589-3233. Email: purchasing@nashuanh.gov. Website: https://www.nashuanh.gov/bids.aspx?bidID=606
notes: RFQ number: RFQ0657-061826. Target market: Streets/Highways. Funding includes LPA and NHDOT. More than one contract may be awarded. Contract duration: 36-month base period with 24-month renewal option. Questions deadline: 2026-06-04 03:00 PM EDT. This appears to be a general municipal on-call services procurement rather than a defined bridge project.
